name: Difficult Terrain
description: Every foot of movement in difficult terrain costs 1 extra foot. This applies even with extra movement from Dash.

name: Prone Movement
description: Crawling while prone costs 1 extra foot of movement per foot. Standing up from prone costs half your movement speed.

name: Climbing
description: Each foot of climbing costs 1 extra foot of movement (2 extra in difficult terrain) unless you have a climbing speed.

name: Swimming
description: Each foot of swimming costs 1 extra foot of movement (2 extra in difficult terrain) unless you have a swimming speed.

name: Long Jump
description: Running long jump covers feet equal to STR score. Standing long jump covers half that distance. May require DC 10 Athletics to clear low obstacles.

name: High Jump
description: Running high jump: 3 + STR modifier feet. Standing high jump: half that distance. Arms can reach 1.5x height above jump.

name: Squeezing
description: A creature can squeeze through a space one size smaller. While squeezing, movement costs 1 extra foot, has disadvantage on attacks and DEX saves, and attacks against have advantage.

name: Flying Movement
description: If a flying creature is knocked prone, has speed reduced to 0, or is otherwise deprived of ability to move, it falls unless it can hover or is held aloft by magic.

name: Mounting and Dismounting
description: Mounting or dismounting costs half your movement speed. If an effect moves your mount against its will, make a DC 10 DEX save or fall prone within 5 feet.

name: Underwater Melee
description: Melee weapon attacks have disadvantage unless the weapon is a dagger, javelin, shortsword, spear, or trident.

name: Underwater Ranged
description: Ranged weapon attacks automatically miss beyond normal range. Even against a target in normal range, attack roll has disadvantage unless weapon is a crossbow, net, or thrown weapon (javelin, spear, trident, dart).
